content.title: About
content.content: A peanut butter sandwich made with regular peanut butter on white bread is a simple, satisfying snack. The soft bread paired with creamy peanut butter provides a quick source of energy and healthy fats.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanut butter first appeared in the United States in the early 20th century and quickly became popular among athletes.
White bread is often used for sandwiches because its neutral flavor doesn’t overpower the taste of peanut butter.
One sandwich typically contains about 190‑210 kcal, depending on the thickness of the peanut butter layer.
Peanut butter is rich in plant‑based protein, making it a favorite among vegetarians.
Over 1.5 billion peanut butter sandwiches are sold annually in the United States.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Peanut butter contains monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: A single serving (≈2 tbsp, 32 g) provides about 8 g of plant protein.

items.title: Contains vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Helps stabilize blood sugar
items.content: The combination of protein and fat slows carbohydrate absorption from the bread, preventing sharp glucose spikes.

items.title: Provides magnesium and potassium
items.content: These minerals support muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: Peanuts are a strong allergen; individuals with a peanut allergy may experience severe reactions.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Large portions can lead to excess calorie intake and weight gain.

items.title: Added salt and sugar
items.content: Some commercial peanut butter brands contain added salt and sugar, which should be considered in a diet.

items.title: Hydrogenated oils and trans fats
items.content: Certain brands use hydrogenated oils that contain trans fats, which are detrimental to heart health.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Spread 1‑2 tablespoons of peanut butter evenly on two slices of white bread and press them together. For variety, add banana slices, honey, or jam.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the assembled sandwich in an airtight container at room temperature for no more than 4 hours. Store opened peanut butter in the refrigerator and keep bread in a dry place.
